newsitem.title: GREECE: NIREFS, MICHANIKI UPDATE FUNDS ON PROSPECTS.
newsitem.headline: NIREFS, MICHANIKI UPDATE FUNDS ON PROSPECTS.

text.p: Nirefs Aquaculture and construction firm Michaniki executives updated mutual and closed-end fund managers on their companies' prospects, the Union of Institutional Investors said in a statement.

The union's members, 30 fund management companies and 17 closed-end investment funds, were briefed on corporate prospects by Michaniki president Prodromos Emfietzoglou and Nirefs president Aristidis Belles.
The union's programme of corporate presentations will continue in January with 40 listings having expressed interest to participate, it said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
